title: Government Unveils New Plan to Boost Urea Production
description: The Union Cabinet recently approved a new policy, NIPU-2026, to increase urea fertilizer production in India. It aims to build 8-9 new gas-based urea plants, .

faq.a: Urea is a widely used nitrogen-based chemical fertilizer that provides essential nutrients to plants, promoting their growth and increasing crop yields.
It means these plants will use natural gas as the primary raw material and energy source to produce urea. This is a common and efficient method for urea manufacturing.

faq.q: How does NIPU-2026 differ from previous policies?
faq.a: NIPU-2026 succeeds and updates the investment window under the New Investment Policy (NIP), 2012, for the urea sector. It introduces a revised incentive framework, greater transparency in costs, and mechanisms to mitigate financial risks, aiming for more predictable returns for investors and lower project costs.

faq.q: Will this affect other types of fertilizers?
faq.a: NIPU-2026 specifically focuses on urea. While a stronger domestic fertilizer sector overall is beneficial, this policy's direct impact is on urea production and supply.

faq.q: When can we expect to see the new plants operational?
faq.a: Building large industrial plants is a multi-year process. While the policy has been approved, it will take time for companies to invest, construct, and commission these 8-9 new plants. The benefits will likely be seen over the next few years as these projects come online.
